questions.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest — it covers more than 30% of Earth's surface! 🌊

questions.question: How many arms does an octopus have?
questions.explanation: Octopuses have 8 arms, each with suckers to grip prey! 🐙

questions.question: What is the fastest fish in the ocean?
questions.explanation: The sailfish can swim at up to 110 km/h — faster than a car on a motorway! 🐟

questions.question: What is the largest animal that has ever lived?
questions.explanation: The blue whale is the largest animal ever — even bigger than dinosaurs! 🐋

questions.question: How do fish breathe underwater?
questions.explanation: Fish use gills to extract oxygen from water — brilliant design! 🐠

questions.question: What colour is an octopus's blood?
questions.explanation: Octopus blood is blue because it uses copper-based haemocyanin instead of iron! 🩵

questions.question: Which sea creature can regenerate lost arms?
questions.explanation: Starfish can regrow lost arms — and some can even grow a whole new body! ⭐
